Adjustment 6: apply a 9% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 9% surcharge, then subtract 11 credits.

Adjustment 10: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 3 credits.

Adjustment 15: add 13 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
